summary: NexPoint Capital, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that as of June 16, 2026 its net asset value per share was $4.43, which is also the price at which shares are issued under its distribution reinvestment plan (DRP). The price is determined by the company's investment adviser in its sole discretion, subject to board-approved valuation policies per Rule 2a-5 under the Investment Company Act of 1940. This filing is a routine disclosure of net asset value and DRP pricing, not a special situation. There are no deal terms or strategic events.
